sectors.name: Technology
themes: Enterprise AI monetization is now visible in US software earnings, driving durable multiple expansion for platform vendors with recurring revenue.
Indonesia's tech sector remains structurally tied to domestic consumption and fintech, where regulatory tightening caps near-term growth versus US peers.
Global cybersecurity spend is a non-discretionary budget line, hardening as AI adoption expands attack surfaces, favoring CRWD and similar pure-plays.
sectors.ai: Accelerate exposure to US-listed AI/software names (PLTR, NOW, ORCL, CRWD) as enterprise spend reaccelerates, but keep ID tech underweight—local names lack earnings catalysts. MSTR's outsized move signals speculative crypto-adjacent demand, not fundamentals; fade it. Buy pullbacks in AI infrastructure and cybersecurity leaders, targeting 15-20% upside over 6 months.

Structural under-penetration of credit in Indonesia, especially MSME and consumer segments, supports sustained loan growth above nominal GDP, benefiting financials with digital distribution.
sectors.ai: Buy Indonesian financials now: the US crypto/brokerage surge (COIN +10%, HOOD +17%) is spilling into local fintech and bank proxies (BTPN +7.8%, INPC +9%), while domestic rate-cut expectations and strong loan growth underpin upside. Rotate into BTPN and IMJS for leveraged beta; trim NICK given its speculative spike.
